itinerary_days.description: Sunrise climb of Sigiriya Rock and afternoon safari at Minneriya. Overnight in Sigiriya.

itinerary_days.title: Polonnaruwa and Kandy
itinerary_days.description: Explore Polonnaruwa, then drive to Kandy via Dambulla. Overnight in Kandy.

itinerary_days.title: Kandy at Leisure
itinerary_days.description: Temple of the Tooth, Peradeniya Gardens, dance show. Overnight in Kandy.

itinerary_days.title: Train to Tea Country
itinerary_days.description: Scenic train to Nanu Oya and tea factory visit. Overnight in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary_days.title: World's End
itinerary_days.description: Sunrise hike at Horton Plains, afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary_days.title: Ella
itinerary_days.description: Scenic drive to Ella. Little Adam's Peak. Overnight in Ella.

itinerary_days.title: Ella at Leisure
itinerary_days.description: Nine Arch Bridge, Ravana Falls, optional cooking class. Overnight in Ella.

itinerary_days.title: Udawalawe and Yala
itinerary_days.description: Udawalawe safari on the way, then on to Yala. Overnight near the park.

itinerary_days.title: Dawn Safari and Mirissa
itinerary_days.description: Early safari in Yala, then the drive to Mirissa. Overnight there.

itinerary_days.title: Whales and Beach
itinerary_days.description: Whale watching (November–April) and free time. Overnight in Mirissa.

itinerary_days.title: Galle
itinerary_days.description: Galle Fort, turtle hatchery and Madu River. Overnight in Galle.

itinerary_days.title: Departure
itinerary_days.description: Transfer to the airport.
